posts.title: new web game: "Up The Vote" as a numbers game
posts.description: Up The Vote is a free short "clicker" / idle / incremental game about increasing young voter enrollment in Aotearoa New Zealand for the upcoming 2026 election. It takes about 0-10 minutes to play on your phone or computer. Note that the game gets more difficult as the real-life October 25th NZ voter enrollment deadline approaches.
